messages:
Priya: Heads-up 1: I started a lightweight refresh of the "Hello Grove" quickstart. Main aims: unify env var names, add a tiny realtime WS echo sample, and fix the broken anchor to /deploy/production.
Evan: Sounds good. Which env var are we standardizing on?
Priya: Thinking RW_API_KEY to match our SDK examples. We'll add a short migration note for existing REDWOOD_API_KEY users.
Chris: I pulled the sample locally. The docker container fails with 401 because README still references REDWOOD_API_KEY while the sample .env uses RW_API_KEY. Simple mismatch.
Priya: Oof. I'll update the README and the compose mount. Can someone run a quick smoke?
Evan: I'll run it on my laptop. Also propose adding an "engines" node field in samples/package.json to pin node>=18.
Nora: For the websocket snippet, can we show the minimal auth header usage and the async iterator streaming for JS SDK? Keep it <20 lines.
Priya: Draft WS snippet (will be shortened):
```js
// hello-grove-ws.js
import WebSocket from 'ws';
const ws = new WebSocket('wss://realtime.redwood.ai/v1', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.RW_API_KEY}` } });
ws.on('open', () => ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'init', model: 'grove-lite' })));
ws.on('message', data => console.log('message', data));
```
Evan: Nice. For the SDK JS streaming change, show async iteration example:
```js
for await (const chunk of client.streamGenerate({ model: 'grove-lite', prompt })) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.text);
}
```
Chris: CI flagged a lint error (line length) in the README code block. I'll tidy. Also saw a dead link to /deploy/production#rolling that needs the anchor 'rolling-updates' instead.
Priya: Thanks, please include the exact anchor fix in the PR. I'll open branch docs/hello-grove-refresh and push the edits.
Evan: Can you add a short callout about token rotation and KMS in the security section? One paragraph.
Priya: Yup. Also adding a short NOTE at the top: "If you're upgrading from old samples that use REDWOOD_API_KEY, set RW_API_KEY or add RW_API_KEY=process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY in .env."
DocsBot: Link check running for PR #7902
Chris: Pushed changes to the branch and updated package.json engines. Running local smoke now.
Evan: CI passed unit tests, samples smoke failed on node v16 image. We should update the CI matrix or add a note about required node v18.
Priya: I'll update CI and README. Nora, can you spare a quick review of the JS snippet?
Nora: Reviewing now. Suggest collapsing the WS example into a 1-file runnable script and adding a tiny expected output line.
DocsBot: Link check passed for PR #7902
Priya: Great. I requested reviews from Evan/Chris/Nora and added the migration callout. Targeting merge by Friday morning. If anything blocks, ping here.
Evan: :eyes:
Chris: :thumbsup:
Nora: LGTM once the line-length and anchor are fixed.
